import Init.Data.String.Basic
import Init.Data.List.Basic
import Init.Control.Lawful.Basic
import Init.Data.List.Monadic

open String

abbrev ampR : List Char := "&".data
abbrev ltR : List Char := "<".data
abbrev gtR : List Char := ">".data
abbrev quotR : List Char := """.data
abbrev aposR : List Char := "'".data

def replaceChar (pat : Char) (repl : List Char) (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  cs.flatMap fun c => if c == pat then repl else [c]

def escapeData (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  let core := replaceChar '>' gtR (replaceChar '<' ltR (replaceChar '&' ampR cs))
  if quote then
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (replaceChar '"' quotR core)
  else
    core

def encodeChar (quote : Bool) (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c == '&' then ampR
  else if c == '<' then ltR
  else if c == '>' then gtR
  else if quote && c == '"' then quotR
  else if quote && c == '\'' then aposR
  else [c]

theorem escapeData_append (quote : Bool) (xs ys : List Char) :
    escapeData quote (xs ++ ys) = escapeData quote xs ++ escapeData quote ys := by
  cases quote <;> simp [escapeData, replaceChar, List.flatMap_append]

theorem escapeData_nil (quote : Bool) : escapeData quote [] = [] := by
  cases quote <;> simp [escapeData, replaceChar]

def enc1 (c : Char) : List Char := if c == '&' then ampR else [c]
def enc2 (c : Char) : List Char := if c == '&' then ampR else if c == '<' then ltR else [c]
def enc3 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c == '&' then ampR else if c == '<' then ltR else if c == '>' then gtR else [c]
def enc4 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c == '&' then ampR else if c == '<' then ltR else if c == '>' then gtR else if c == '"' then quotR else [c]
def enc5 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c == '&' then ampR else if c == '<' then ltR else if c == '>' then gtR else if c == '"' then quotR else if c == '\'' then aposR else [c]

theorem replaceChar_of_not_mem {q : Char} {rq xs : List Char} (h : q ∉ xs) :
    replaceChar q rq xs = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ≠ q := by
      intro heq
      exact h (by simp [heq])
    have hxs : q ∉ xs := fun hm => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
    have hb : (x == q) = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr hx
    simp only [replaceChar, List.flatMap_cons, hb, cond_false]
    rw [ih hxs]
    simp

theorem replace_one (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (c : Char)
    (hf_skip : c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (f c) = if c == q then rq else f c := by
  by_cases hq : c = q
  · have hb : (c == q) = true := beq_iff_eq.mpr hq
    rw [hf_id hq]
    simp [replaceChar, hb]
  · have hb : (c == q) = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr hq
    rw [replaceChar_of_not_mem (hf_skip hq)]
    simp [hb]

theorem replaceChar_append (q : Char) (rq xs ys : List Char) :
    replaceChar q rq (xs ++ ys) = replaceChar q rq xs ++ replaceChar q rq ys := by
  simp [replaceChar, List.flatMap_append]

theorem replace_on_cascade (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (cs : List Char)
    (hf_skip : ∀ c, c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : ∀ c, c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (cs.flatMap f) =
      cs.flatMap fun c => if c == q then rq else f c := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, replaceChar_append, ih,
      replace_one q rq f c (hf_skip c) (hf_id c)]

-- membership facts used when the searched character is concrete
theorem enc1_id_lt (c : Char) (h : c = '<') : enc1 c = [c] := by
  subst h; unfold enc1; decide

theorem lt_not_amp : '<' ∉ ampR := by decide

theorem enc1_skip_lt (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '<') : '<' ∉ enc1 c := by
  simp only [enc1]
  by_cases hc : c = '&'
  · subst hc
    simp [lt_not_amp]
  · have hb : (c == '&') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr hc
    simp only [hb, cond_false, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc2 (c : Char) : (if c == '<' then ltR else enc1 c) = enc2 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  · simp [enc1, enc2, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2]

theorem after_lt (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '<' ltR (cs.flatMap enc1) = cs.flatMap enc2 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '<' ltR enc1 cs enc1_skip_lt enc1_id_lt]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc2 c

theorem enc2_id_gt (c : Char) (h : c = '>') : enc2 c = [c] := by
  subst h; unfold enc2; decide

theorem gt_not_amp : '>' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem gt_not_lt : '>' ∉ ltR := by decide

theorem enc2_skip_gt (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '>') : '>' ∉ enc2 c := by
  simp only [enc2]
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simp [gt_not_amp]
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simp [gt_not_lt]
  · have hb1 : (c == '&') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1
    have hb2 : (c == '<') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2
    simp only [hb1, hb2, cond_false, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc3 (c : Char) : (if c == '>' then gtR else enc2 c) = enc3 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  · simp [enc2, enc3, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h3]

theorem after_gt (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '>' gtR (cs.flatMap enc2) = cs.flatMap enc3 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '>' gtR enc2 cs enc2_skip_gt enc2_id_gt]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc3 c

theorem core_eq (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '>' gtR (replaceChar '<' ltR (replaceChar '&' ampR cs)) = cs.flatMap enc3 := by
  have h1 : replaceChar '&' ampR cs = cs.flatMap enc1 := rfl
  rw [h1, after_lt, after_gt]

theorem enc3_id_quot (c : Char) (h : c = '"') : enc3 c = [c] := by
  subst h; unfold enc3; decide

theorem quot_not_amp : '"' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem quot_not_lt : '"' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem quot_not_gt : '"' ∉ gtR := by decide

theorem enc3_skip_quot (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '"') : '"' ∉ enc3 c := by
  simp only [enc3]
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simp [quot_not_amp]
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simp [quot_not_lt]
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; simp [quot_not_gt]
  · have hb1 : (c == '&') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1
    have hb2 : (c == '<') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2
    have hb3 : (c == '>') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h3
    simp only [hb1, hb2, hb3, cond_false, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc4 (c : Char) : (if c == '"' then quotR else enc3 c) = enc4 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; decide
  · simp [enc3, enc4, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2,
      beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h3, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h4]

theorem after_quot (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '"' quotR (cs.flatMap enc3) = cs.flatMap enc4 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '"' quotR enc3 cs enc3_skip_quot enc3_id_quot]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc4 c

theorem enc4_id_apos (c : Char) (h : c = '\'') : enc4 c = [c] := by
  subst h; unfold enc4; decide

theorem apos_not_lt : '\'' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem apos_not_gt : '\'' ∉ gtR := by decide
theorem apos_not_quot : '\'' ∉ quotR := by decide

  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simp [apos_not_amp]
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simp [apos_not_lt]

  · subst h3; simp [apos_not_gt]

  · subst h4; simp [apos_not_quot]
  · have hb1 : (c == '&') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1
    have hb2 : (c == '<') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2
    have hb3 : (c == '>') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h3
    have hb4 : (c == '"') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h4
    simp only [hb1, hb2, hb3, hb4, cond_false, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; decide
  by_cases h5 : c = '\''
  · subst h5; decide
  · simp [enc4, enc5, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2,
      beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h3, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h4, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h5]

theorem after_apos (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (cs.flatMap enc4) = cs.flatMap enc5 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '\'' aposR enc4 cs enc4_skip_apos enc4_id_apos]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc5 c

theorem enc3_encode_false (c : Char) : enc3 c = encodeChar false c := by
  simp [enc3, encodeChar, Bool.false_and]

theorem enc5_encode_true (c : Char) : enc5 c = encodeChar true c := by
  simp [enc5, encodeChar, Bool.true_and]

theorem escapeData_eq_flatMap (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) :
    escapeData quote cs = cs.flatMap (encodeChar quote) := by
  cases quote with
  | false =>
    rw [show escapeData false cs = cs.flatMap enc3 by simp [escapeData, core_eq]]
    apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
    funext c
    exact enc3_encode_false c
  | true =>
    rw [show escapeData true cs = cs.flatMap enc5 by simp [escapeData, core_eq, after_quot, after_apos]]
    apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)

open String

abbrev ampR : List Char := "&".data
abbrev ltR : List Char := "<".data
abbrev gtR : List Char := ">".data
abbrev quotR : List Char := """.data
abbrev aposR : List Char := "'".data

/-- Python `str.replace` for a one-character pattern. The replacement is not re-scanned. -/
def replaceChar (pat : Char) (repl : List Char) : List Char → List Char
  | [] => []
  | c :: cs => (if c = pat then repl else [c]) ++ replaceChar pat repl cs

/-- One original character, encoded the way `html.escape` encodes it. -/
def encodeChar (quote : Bool) (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR
  else if c = '<' then ltR
  else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '"' then quotR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '\'' then aposR
  else [c]

/-- Successive replacements, in the same order as Python's `html.escape`. -/
def escapeData (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  let core := replaceChar '>' gtR (replaceChar '<' ltR (replaceChar '&' ampR cs))
  if quote = true then
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (replaceChar '"' quotR core)
  else
    core

def escape (s : String) (quote : Bool := true) : String :=
  ⟨escapeData quote s.data⟩

theorem replaceChar_append (pat : Char) (repl xs ys : List Char) :
    replaceChar pat repl (xs ++ ys) = replaceChar pat repl xs ++ replaceChar pat repl ys := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [replaceChar, ih, List.append_assoc]

theorem replaceChar_of_not_mem {pat : Char} {repl xs : List Char} (h : pat ∉ xs) :
    replaceChar pat repl xs = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ≠ pat := by
      intro heq
      exact h (by simp [heq])
    have hxs : pat ∉ xs := fun hm => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
    simp [replaceChar, hx, ih hxs]

theorem replace_one (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (c : Char)
    (hf_skip : c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (f c) = if c = q then rq else f c := by
  by_cases hq : c = q
  · simp [replaceChar, hf_id hq, hq]
  · simp [replaceChar_of_not_mem (hf_skip hq), hq]

theorem replace_on_cascade (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (cs : List Char)
    (hf_skip : ∀ c, c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : ∀ c, c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (cs.flatMap f) = cs.flatMap fun c => if c = q then rq else f c := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, replaceChar_append, ih,
      replace_one q rq f c (hf_skip c) (hf_id c)]

def enc2 (c : Char) : List Char := if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else [c]
def enc3 (c : Char) : List Char :=

def enc4 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else if c = '>' then gtR

theorem gt_not_amp : '>' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem gt_not_lt : '>' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem quot_not_amp : '"' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem quot_not_lt : '"' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem quot_not_gt : '"' ∉ gtR := by decide
theorem apos_not_amp : '\'' ∉ ampR := by decide

theorem apos_not_gt : '\'' ∉ gtR := by decide

  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; simpa using apos_not_gt
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; simpa using apos_not_quot
  · simp [h1, h2, h3, h4, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

  · subst h2; decide

  · subst h3; decide

  · subst h4; decide
  by_cases h5 : c = '\''

  · simp [enc4, enc5, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]

open String

abbrev ampR : List Char := "&".data
abbrev ltR : List Char := "<".data
abbrev gtR : List Char := ">".data
abbrev quotR : List Char := """.data
abbrev aposR : List Char := "'".data

/-- Python `str.replace` for a one-character pattern. The replacement is not re-scanned. -/
def replaceChar (pat : Char) (repl : List Char) : List Char → List Char
  | [] => []
  | c :: cs => (if c = pat then repl else [c]) ++ replaceChar pat repl cs

/-- One original character, encoded the way `html.escape` encodes it. -/
def encodeChar (quote : Bool) (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR
  else if c = '<' then ltR
  else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '"' then quotR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '\'' then aposR
  else [c]

/-- Successive replacements, in the same order as Python's `html.escape`. -/
def escapeData (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  let core := replaceChar '>' gtR (replaceChar '<' ltR (replaceChar '&' ampR cs))
  if quote = true then
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (replaceChar '"' quotR core)
  else
    core

def escape (s : String) (quote : Bool := true) : String :=
  ⟨escapeData quote s.data⟩

theorem replaceChar_append (pat : Char) (repl xs ys : List Char) :
    replaceChar pat repl (xs ++ ys) = replaceChar pat repl xs ++ replaceChar pat repl ys := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [replaceChar, ih, List.append_assoc]

theorem replaceChar_of_not_mem {pat : Char} {repl xs : List Char} (h : pat ∉ xs) :
    replaceChar pat repl xs = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ≠ pat := by
      intro heq
      exact h (by simp [heq])
    have hxs : pat ∉ xs := fun hm => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
    simp [replaceChar, hx, ih hxs]

theorem replace_one (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (c : Char)
    (hf_skip : c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (f c) = if c = q then rq else f c := by
  by_cases hq : c = q
  · simp [replaceChar, hf_id hq, hq]
  · simp [replaceChar_of_not_mem (hf_skip hq), hq]

theorem replace_on_cascade (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (cs : List Char)
    (hf_skip : ∀ c, c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : ∀ c, c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (cs.flatMap f) = cs.flatMap fun c => if c = q then rq else f c := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, replaceChar_append, ih,
      replace_one q rq f c (hf_skip c) (hf_id c)]

def enc2 (c : Char) : List Char := if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else [c]
def enc3 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else if c = '>' then gtR else [c]
def enc4 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if c = '"' then quotR else [c]
def enc5 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if c = '"' then quotR else if c = '\'' then aposR else [c]

theorem lt_not_amp : '<' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem gt_not_amp : '>' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem gt_not_lt : '>' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem quot_not_amp : '"' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem quot_not_lt : '"' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem quot_not_gt : '"' ∉ gtR := by decide
theorem apos_not_amp : '\'' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem apos_not_lt : '\'' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem apos_not_gt : '\'' ∉ gtR := by decide
theorem apos_not_quot : '\'' ∉ quotR := by decide

theorem enc1_skip_lt (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '<') : '<' ∉ enc1 c := by

    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc2 (c : Char) : (if c = '<' then ltR else enc1 c) = enc2 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  · simp [enc1, enc2, h1, h2]

theorem after_lt (cs : List Char) :

  funext c
  exact step_enc2 c

  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simpa using gt_not_lt

  · subst h2; decide

  have h1 : replaceChar '&' ampR cs = cs.flatMap enc1 := by
    induction cs with

  rw [h1, after_lt, after_gt]

  subst h; decide

  simp only [enc3]
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simpa using quot_not_amp
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simpa using quot_not_lt
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; simpa using quot_not_gt

  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; decide

    replaceChar '"' quotR (cs.flatMap enc3) = cs.flatMap enc4 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '"' quotR enc3 cs enc3_skip_quot enc3_id_quot]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc4 c

theorem enc4_id_apos (c : Char) (h : c = '\'') : enc4 c = [c] := by
  subst h; decide

theorem enc4_skip_apos (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '\'') : '\'' ∉ enc4 c := by
  simp only [enc4]
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simpa using apos_not_amp
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simpa using apos_not_lt
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; simpa using apos_not_gt
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; simpa using apos_not_quot
  · simp [h1, h2, h3, h4, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc5 (c : Char) : (if c = '\'' then aposR else enc4 c) = enc5 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; decide
  by_cases h5 : c = '\''
  · subst h5; decide
  · simp [enc4, enc5, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]

theorem after_apos (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (cs.flatMap enc4) = cs.flatMap enc5 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '\'' aposR enc4 cs enc4_skip_apos enc4_id_apos]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc5 c

  simp [enc3, encodeChar]

theorem enc5_encode_true (c : Char) : enc5 c = encodeChar true c := by
  simp [enc5, encodeChar]

    escapeData quote cs = cs.flatMap (encodeChar quote) := by
  cases quote with
  | false =>

    apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)

  | true =>

  simp [escape, escapeData_eq_flatMap]

    escape (s ++ t) quote = escape s quote ++ escape t quote := by
  apply String.ext
  simp [escape, String.data_append, escapeData_eq_flatMap, List.flatMap_append]

  unfold encodeChar
  split_ifs
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · simp [List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    -- last hypothesis is not used; the second split is ¬ c = '<'
    rename_i _ hlt _ _ _
    exact hlt heq.symm

  intro h

    have hb2 : (c == '<') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2
    have hb3 : (c == '>') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h3
    have hb4 : (c == '"') = false := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h4
    simp only [hb1, hb2, hb3, hb4, cond_false, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc5 (c : Char) : (if c == '\'' then aposR else enc4 c) = enc5 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; decide
  by_cases h5 : c = '\''
  · subst h5; decide
  · simp [enc4, enc5, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h1, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h2,
      beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h3, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h4, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr h5]

theorem after_apos (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (cs.flatMap enc4) = cs.flatMap enc5 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '\'' aposR enc4 cs enc4_skip_apos enc4_id_apos]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc5 c

theorem enc3_encode_false (c : Char) : enc3 c = encodeChar false c := by
  simp [enc3, encodeChar, Bool.false_and]

theorem enc5_encode_true (c : Char) : enc5 c = encodeChar true c := by
  simp [enc5, encodeChar, Bool.true_and]

theorem escapeData_eq_flatMap (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) :
    escapeData quote cs = cs.flatMap (encodeChar quote) := by
  cases quote with
  | false =>
    rw [show escapeData false cs = cs.flatMap enc3 by simp [escapeData, core_eq]]
    apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
    funext c
    exact enc3_encode_false c
  | true =>
    rw [show escapeData true cs = cs.flatMap enc5 by simp [escapeData, core_eq, after_quot, after_apos]]
    apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
    funext c
    exact enc5_encode_true c

def escape (s : String) (quote : Bool := true) : String :=
  ⟨escapeData quote s.data⟩

theorem one_pass (s : String) (quote : Bool) :
    (escape s quote).data = s.data.flatMap (encodeChar quote) := by
  simp [escape, escapeData_eq_flatMap]

theorem amp_thm (quote : Bool) : escape "&" quote = "&" := by
  cases quote <;> decide

import Init.Data.String.Basic
import Init.Data.List.Basic
import Init.Control.Lawful.Basic

open String

abbrev ampR : List Char := "&".data
abbrev ltR : List Char := "<".data
abbrev gtR : List Char := ">".data
abbrev quotR : List Char := """.data
abbrev aposR : List Char := "'".data

/-- Python `str.replace` for a one-character pattern. The replacement is not re-scanned. -/
def replaceChar (pat : Char) (repl : List Char) : List Char → List Char
  | [] => []
  | c :: cs => (if c = pat then repl else [c]) ++ replaceChar pat repl cs

/-- One original character, encoded the way `html.escape` encodes it. -/
def encodeChar (quote : Bool) (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR
  else if c = '<' then ltR
  else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '"' then quotR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '\'' then aposR
  else [c]

/-- Successive replacements, in the same order as Python's `html.escape`. -/
def escapeData (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  let core := replaceChar '>' gtR (replaceChar '<' ltR (replaceChar '&' ampR cs))
  if quote = true then
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (replaceChar '"' quotR core)
  else
    core

def escape (s : String) (quote : Bool := true) : String :=
  ⟨escapeData quote s.data⟩

theorem replaceChar_append (pat : Char) (repl xs ys : List Char) :
    replaceChar pat repl (xs ++ ys) = replaceChar pat repl xs ++ replaceChar pat repl ys := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [replaceChar, ih, List.append_assoc]

theorem replaceChar_of_not_mem {pat : Char} {repl xs : List Char} (h : pat ∉ xs) :
    replaceChar pat repl xs = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ≠ pat := by
      intro heq
      exact h (by simp [heq])
    have hxs : pat ∉ xs := fun hm => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
    simp [replaceChar, hx, ih hxs]

theorem replace_one (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (c : Char)
    (hf_skip : c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (f c) = if c = q then rq else f c := by
  by_cases hq : c = q
  · simp [replaceChar, hf_id hq, hq]
  · simp [replaceChar_of_not_mem (hf_skip hq), hq]

theorem replace_on_cascade (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (cs : List Char)
    (hf_skip : ∀ c, c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : ∀ c, c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (cs.flatMap f) = cs.flatMap fun c => if c = q then rq else f c := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, replaceChar_append, ih,
      replace_one q rq f c (hf_skip c) (hf_id c)]

def enc1 (c : Char) : List Char := if c = '&' then ampR else [c]
def enc2 (c : Char) : List Char := if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else [c]
def enc3 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else if c = '>' then gtR else [c]
def enc4 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if c = '"' then quotR else [c]
def enc5 (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR else if c = '<' then ltR else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if c = '"' then quotR else if c = '\'' then aposR else [c]

theorem lt_not_amp : '<' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem gt_not_amp : '>' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem gt_not_lt : '>' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem quot_not_amp : '"' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem quot_not_lt : '"' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem quot_not_gt : '"' ∉ gtR := by decide
theorem apos_not_amp : '\'' ∉ ampR := by decide
theorem apos_not_lt : '\'' ∉ ltR := by decide
theorem apos_not_gt : '\'' ∉ gtR := by decide
theorem apos_not_quot : '\'' ∉ quotR := by decide

theorem enc1_id_lt (c : Char) (h : c = '<') : enc1 c = [c] := by
  subst h; decide

theorem enc1_skip_lt (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '<') : '<' ∉ enc1 c := by
  simp only [enc1]
  by_cases hc : c = '&'
  · subst hc; simpa using lt_not_amp
  · simp [hc, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc2 (c : Char) : (if c = '<' then ltR else enc1 c) = enc2 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  · simp [enc1, enc2, h1, h2]

theorem after_lt (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '<' ltR (cs.flatMap enc1) = cs.flatMap enc2 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '<' ltR enc1 cs enc1_skip_lt enc1_id_lt]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc2 c

theorem enc2_id_gt (c : Char) (h : c = '>') : enc2 c = [c] := by
  subst h; decide

theorem enc2_skip_gt (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '>') : '>' ∉ enc2 c := by
  simp only [enc2]
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simpa using gt_not_amp
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simpa using gt_not_lt
  · simp [h1, h2, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc3 (c : Char) : (if c = '>' then gtR else enc2 c) = enc3 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  · simp [enc2, enc3, h1, h2, h3]

theorem after_gt (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '>' gtR (cs.flatMap enc2) = cs.flatMap enc3 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '>' gtR enc2 cs enc2_skip_gt enc2_id_gt]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc3 c

theorem core_eq (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '>' gtR (replaceChar '<' ltR (replaceChar '&' ampR cs)) = cs.flatMap enc3 := by
  have h1 : replaceChar '&' ampR cs = cs.flatMap enc1 := by
    induction cs with
    | nil => simp [replaceChar]
    | cons c cs ih => simp [replaceChar, enc1, ih]
  rw [h1, after_lt, after_gt]

theorem enc3_id_quot (c : Char) (h : c = '"') : enc3 c = [c] := by
  subst h; decide

theorem enc3_skip_quot (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '"') : '"' ∉ enc3 c := by
  simp only [enc3]
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simpa using quot_not_amp
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simpa using quot_not_lt
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; simpa using quot_not_gt
  · simp [h1, h2, h3, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc4 (c : Char) : (if c = '"' then quotR else enc3 c) = enc4 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; decide
  · simp [enc3, enc4, h1, h2, h3, h4]

theorem after_quot (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '"' quotR (cs.flatMap enc3) = cs.flatMap enc4 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '"' quotR enc3 cs enc3_skip_quot enc3_id_quot]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc4 c

theorem enc4_id_apos (c : Char) (h : c = '\'') : enc4 c = [c] := by
  subst h; decide

theorem enc4_skip_apos (c : Char) (h : c ≠ '\'') : '\'' ∉ enc4 c := by
  simp only [enc4]
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; simpa using apos_not_amp
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; simpa using apos_not_lt
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; simpa using apos_not_gt
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; simpa using apos_not_quot
  · simp [h1, h2, h3, h4, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    exact h heq.symm

theorem step_enc5 (c : Char) : (if c = '\'' then aposR else enc4 c) = enc5 c := by
  by_cases h1 : c = '&'
  · subst h1; decide
  by_cases h2 : c = '<'
  · subst h2; decide
  by_cases h3 : c = '>'
  · subst h3; decide
  by_cases h4 : c = '"'
  · subst h4; decide
  by_cases h5 : c = '\''
  · subst h5; decide
  · simp [enc4, enc5, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]

theorem after_apos (cs : List Char) :
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (cs.flatMap enc4) = cs.flatMap enc5 := by
  rw [replace_on_cascade '\'' aposR enc4 cs enc4_skip_apos enc4_id_apos]
  apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
  funext c
  exact step_enc5 c

theorem enc3_encode_false (c : Char) : enc3 c = encodeChar false c := by
  simp [enc3, encodeChar]

theorem enc5_encode_true (c : Char) : enc5 c = encodeChar true c := by
  simp [enc5, encodeChar]

theorem escapeData_eq_flatMap (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) :
    escapeData quote cs = cs.flatMap (encodeChar quote) := by
  cases quote with
  | false =>
    rw [show escapeData false cs = cs.flatMap enc3 by simp [escapeData, core_eq]]
    apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
    funext c
    exact enc3_encode_false c
  | true =>
    rw [show escapeData true cs = cs.flatMap enc5 by
      simp [escapeData, core_eq, after_quot, after_apos]]
    apply congrArg (fun f => cs.flatMap f)
    funext c
    exact enc5_encode_true c

theorem one_pass (s : String) (quote : Bool) :
    (escape s quote).data = s.data.flatMap (encodeChar quote) := by
  simp [escape, escapeData_eq_flatMap]

theorem escape_append (s t : String) (quote : Bool) :
    escape (s ++ t) quote = escape s quote ++ escape t quote := by
  apply String.ext
  simp [escape, String.data_append, escapeData_eq_flatMap, List.flatMap_append]

theorem encodeChar_no_lt (quote : Bool) (c : Char) : '<' ∉ encodeChar quote c := by
  unfold encodeChar
  split_ifs
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · simp [List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    -- last hypothesis is not used; the second split is ¬ c = '<'
    rename_i _ hlt _ _ _
    exact hlt heq.symm

theorem no_raw_lt (s : String) (quote : Bool) : '<' ∉ (escape s quote).data := by
  rw [one_pass]
  intro h
  rcases List.mem_flatMap.mp h with ⟨c, _, hc⟩
  exact encodeChar_no_lt quote c hc

#print axioms escapeData_eq_flatMap
#print axioms escape_append
#print axioms no_raw_lt

Good progress has been made. Only a few errors remain.

The `replace_one` proof fails because `simp` does not apply `hf_id hq` to the goal `replaceChar q rq (f q) = rq`. After substituting `c` with `q`, the goal becomes `f q`, but `simp` does not rewrite `f c` to `f q` before attempting to use the hypothesis.

The `replace_one` proof will use `subst hq` followed by `simp [replaceChar, hf_id rfl]` to rewrite `f q` to `[q]`. The `encodeChar_no_lt` proof has a tactic syntax issue with `rename_i` in Lean 4. `split_ifs` also failed to split the goal.

The `split_ifs` tactic did not fail silently; the proof was interrupted by the `rename_i` error. The original if-expression goal remains unsolved. `rename_i` is available in Lean 4.22, so its unknown status is unexpected.

The `split_ifs` tactic likely failed because the conditional uses decidable propositions that cannot be split. The proof was interrupted by the `rename_i` error before reaching the case analysis. I will read the end of the file to verify the line numbers.

The unused `List.mem_singleton` warnings are harmless; `simp` already simplified those membership checks. The `skip` proofs succeeded, and the `enc1_skip_lt` theorems are now valid. `escapeData_eq_flatMap` still depends on `sorry` because the failed `replace_one` proof blocks it, but the cascade should resolve once that proof is fixed. The `#print axioms` output showing `sorry` is likely a side effect of Lean inserting `sorry` into tactic proofs when compilation fails.

The `encodeChar_no_lt` proof will use `by_cases` on `c = '&'`, `c = '<'`, and `c = '>'` instead of `rename_i`. Once `replace_one` and `encodeChar_no_lt` are fixed, the remaining proofs should compile cleanly.

The `encodeChar_no_lt` proof will use nested `by_cases` on `c = '&'`, `c = '<'`, `c = '>'`, `quote = true ∧ c = '"'`, and `quote = true ∧ c = '\''`. After unfolding `encodeChar`, the first branch simplifies to `&` and `decide` proves the membership is empty. When `c = '<'`, `simp` reduces `encodeChar` to `ltR`, and `decide` proves the character is absent. The final branch uses `List.mem_singleton` and `h2` to derive a contradiction.

The `length_flatMap_ge` proof needs `omega` or `add_comm` to fix an arithmetic issue.

The `length_flatMap_ge` proof will use induction on `List Char`. The base case is trivial. The step case applies `encodeChar_len_ge` and `omega`. A manual `calc` proof is a fallback if `omega` is unavailable.

The manual `calc` proof for `length_flatMap_ge` is now complete. It uses `Nat.add_le_add_left` and `Nat.add_comm` to match the goal exactly.

A type error appeared in `flatMap_id_of`. `List.mem_cons_self` is a theorem, not a function, and its implicit arguments are stuck.

`List.mem_cons_self` is a theorem with implicit arguments, so it already has a type with metavariables. Applying `c` to it fails because the implicit arguments are not resolved. The correct approach is to use the theorem directly without arguments.

The `flatMap_id_of` proof now applies the induction hypothesis correctly. It uses `List.mem_cons_self` with explicit arguments `(a := c) (as := cs)`, derives `f c = [c]` and `f x = [x]` for members of `cs`, then simplifies with `List.flatMap_cons` and the hypotheses.

The `length_exact` proof is stuck on the goal `escapeData quote s.data = (List.map (encodeChar quote) s.data).flatten`.

`List.length_flatMap` is a `grind` lemma, so `simp` does not rewrite `flatMap` into `flatten` automatically. The goal shifted from a length inequality to an equality of lists because `String.length` reduced to `List.length`, and something incorrectly unfolded `flatMap` into `flatten`.

The `length_exact` proof uses `simp [escape, String.length_mk, escapeData_eq_flatMap, List.length_flatMap]`. The goal still becomes a list equality instead of a length equation. This suggests `String.length_mk` or another simp lemma is causing an unwanted rewrite.

The error at line 448 is in `equiv_thm`, not `length_exact`. The `simp` there is rewriting `escapeData` to `flatMap` and dropping the `.length` suffix, which explains the list equality goal.

The `case h` goal is a `String.ext` proof obligation. The `escapeData_eq_flatMap` theorem was omitted from the `simp` list, so `escapeData` was not rewritten to `flatMap`. The `one_pass` theorem was also unused.

The `simp` call in `equiv_thm` must include `escapeData_eq_flatMap` and `foldl_append_init` so `escapeData` reduces to `flatMap`. The `one_pass` lemma may not fire if the goal involves `escapeData` rather than `(escape ...).data`. The three proofs will be fixed now. `length_exact` might have succeeded after all.

import Init.Data.String.Basic
import Init.Data.List.Basic
import Init.Control.Lawful.Basic

open String

abbrev ampR : List Char := "&".data
abbrev ltR : List Char := "<".data
abbrev gtR : List Char := ">".data
abbrev quotR : List Char := """.data
abbrev aposR : List Char := "'".data

/-- Python `str.replace` for a one-character pattern. The replacement is not re-scanned. -/
def replaceChar (pat : Char) (repl : List Char) : List Char → List Char
  | [] => []
  | c :: cs => (if c = pat then repl else [c]) ++ replaceChar pat repl cs

/-- One original character, encoded the way `html.escape` encodes it. -/
def encodeChar (quote : Bool) (c : Char) : List Char :=
  if c = '&' then ampR
  else if c = '<' then ltR
  else if c = '>' then gtR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '"' then quotR
  else if quote = true ∧ c = '\'' then aposR
  else [c]

/-- Successive replacements, in the same order as Python's `html.escape`. -/
def escapeData (quote : Bool) (cs : List Char) : List Char :=
  let core := replaceChar '>' gtR (replaceChar '<' ltR (replaceChar '&' ampR cs))
  if quote = true then
    replaceChar '\'' aposR (replaceChar '"' quotR core)
  else
    core

def escape (s : String) (quote : Bool := true) : String :=
  ⟨escapeData quote s.data⟩

theorem replaceChar_append (pat : Char) (repl xs ys : List Char) :
    replaceChar pat repl (xs ++ ys) = replaceChar pat repl xs ++ replaceChar pat repl ys := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [replaceChar, ih, List.append_assoc]

theorem replaceChar_of_not_mem {pat : Char} {repl xs : List Char} (h : pat ∉ xs) :
    replaceChar pat repl xs = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x ≠ pat := by
      intro heq
      exact h (by simp [heq])
    have hxs : pat ∉ xs := fun hm => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
    simp [replaceChar, hx, ih hxs]

theorem replace_one (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (c : Char)
    (hf_skip : c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (f c) = if c = q then rq else f c := by
  by_cases hq : c = q
  · subst hq
    have hid : f c = [c] := hf_id rfl
    rw [hid]
    simp [replaceChar]
  · simp [replaceChar_of_not_mem (hf_skip hq), hq]

theorem replace_on_cascade (q : Char) (rq : List Char) (f : Char → List Char) (cs : List Char)
    (hf_skip : ∀ c, c ≠ q → q ∉ f c) (hf_id : ∀ c, c = q → f c = [c]) :
    replaceChar q rq (cs.flatMap f) = cs.flatMap fun c => if c = q then rq else f c := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [replaceChar]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, replaceChar_append, ih,
      replace_one q rq f c (hf_skip c) (hf_id c)]

`apply` should unfold the implication definition to match the goal. If it fails, `exact preserves_safe_thm s false (fun c hc => ...)` is a fallback. Compilation will take a while due to Mathlib.

Compilation timeout set to ten minutes. A syntax check will run before the long build. `safe_char_thm` correctly matches `escape_of_safe`'s conclusion. Verifying whether `nomatch hq` works for `False` from `false = true`.
